pages.title: Rootbinders
text: “Roots are the only rope the void respects.”

pages.title: Who they are
text: The Rootbinders planted the first living anchors on the falling islands and bound them root to root. Their anchors held for a season, and that season is why anything is still up here. Their craft is **living anchors and March flora**.
Their camps stand in **forests** and jungles, and a second camp keeps the old road on the March steppe.

pages.title: What they want
text: Their reagent is the **Mossback Scale**, worth **+8** standing at their hearth.
They also favour saplings, seeds, a Moss Block or Spirit Reed: **+3** each. Any other food is worth **+1**, and a charged Pulse Cell **+2 for every 10 Pulse**, up to +8.
Remember the hearth takes at most **60** standing a day from offerings; see [Tribes and standing](standing).

pages.title: What the Elder trades
text: **Guest**: 4 Oak Saplings for 3 Spirit Reed; 12 Wheat Seeds for 8 Bone Meal.
**Friend**: 6 Spirit Reed for a Wave Drum; 8 Moss Blocks for a Mossback Scale.
**Kin**: 8 Echo Shards for 6 March Logs; 2 Spiritweave for 2 Echo Blooms.

pages.title: Their Mark and totem
text: At **Voice** the Elder gives you the Rootbinders' Tribe Mark. Craft it with a {item:tribalpower:resonance_totem_water} and two Spiritweave into their [Kinship Totem](kinship_totem).
Beside a Pulse Resonator it is one more voice; beside a station it lends **Water**.
The Rootbinders are the only tribe that sells a **Wave Drum**, the Water generator.
Kin of the Rootbinders carry their [boon](tribe_boons): crops and saplings within 4 blocks grow faster around you.
